_readme: Curated source of truth for the portfolio. Edit this, then run Sync-Portfolio (or `node sync.js`) to regenerate content.js. Paths are RELATIVE to the site root. Projects live in assets/projects/<slug>/gallery/, certificates in assets/certificates/, profile photos in assets/profile/. Existing projects are curated (their media list lives here); a brand-new folder dropped into assets/projects/ is auto-included so nothing is lost.

card.name: Feather Touch
card.desc: Branding, promotional and marketing creatives for a beauty salon.

feather-touch.title: Feather Touch Beauty Studio
feather-touch.summary: A complete visual identity and marketing system for a premium beauty salon — from brandmark to daily social content.

story.challenge: The studio needed a cohesive identity that felt premium and refined while working across print, signage and daily social posts.
story.approach: I built the identity around a marble-and-gold brandmark and an editorial type system, then extended it into price lists, interior signage and social templates.
story.outcome: A consistent, salon-grade brand kit that keeps every touchpoint — from window signage to Instagram — visually on-brand.

card.name: Suprams Info Solutions

suprams.title: Suprams Info Solutions
suprams.summary: An ongoing marketing-design system for a B2B IT company spanning software, hardware, cloud and digital-marketing services.

story.challenge: The company needed a steady stream of collateral across many service lines without losing brand consistency.
story.approach: I designed a modular flyer-and-EDM system with reusable layouts, iconography and colour coding so campaigns could ship quickly and stay unmistakably Suprams.
story.outcome: The templated system cut creative turnaround by roughly 25% while keeping a uniform corporate look across dozens of service-specific pieces.

agnitra.title: Agnitra Foundation
agnitra.summary: Social and communication design for a spiritual foundation across a busy calendar of festivals, events and awareness campaigns.

story.challenge: The retailer needed advertising that made upgrade kits and accessories look aspirational and clearly relevant to each vehicle model.

card.name: Krishna Astro Vision
card.desc: Branding and promotional communication for an astrology-service brand.
card.alt: Krishna Astro Vision — astrology brand identity key visual

krishna-astro.title: Krishna Astro Vision
krishna-astro.summary: A fuller brand-identity direction built out from an existing logo, presented as concept mockups.

story.challenge: The brand existed only as a logo and needed a fuller identity direction to feel like a complete, credible astrology brand.
